entry.title: A 120-hour plan for a small conversational model
entry.summary: A fixed five-day experiment proposes a fresh tokenizer, roughly 100 million base-training tokens, and separate tests of model behavior and guarded tool use. These are plans and release goals, not results.

entry.title: An isolated environment and the first bounded GPU diagnostic
entry.summary: A 97.5M-parameter model passes six correctness checks and a short Radeon 8060S benchmark, with explicit limits on what those results demonstrate.

entry.title: Access, resource inventory, and setup status
entry.summary: A read-only inventory establishes the starting point for a small model experiment: capable hardware, occupied GPU memory, and an unverified training environment.
